reply.thought: The first step is to list all orders to get the customer list and their order details, which is necessary to calculate the net balance for each customer before recording payouts. I will use the list_orders tool.
Now that I have the list of orders, I need to check the net balance for each unique customer ('acme', 'birch', 'cobalt') using the net_balance tool. I will check them one by one.
Next, I will check the net balance for 'birch'.
Finally, I will check the net balance for 'cobalt'.

I have retrieved the net balance for all customers: acme (14779 cents), birch (20211 cents), and cobalt (43710 cents). The previous step confirmed that Alpha Co's refunds were applied. Since I have calculated the net balances for all customers and confirmed the refund application, I can now proceed to record the payouts for each customer. I will record one payout per customer.
Successfully recorded payout for acme. Next, I will record the payout for birch.
Successfully recorded payout for birch. Finally, I will record the payout for cobalt.
All payouts have been recorded successfully for acme, birch, and cobalt. I can now finalize the task by reporting the payouts made.
